answer: Require each agent identity to lock a basalt-hard deposit that unlocks only gradually as it completes verifiable useful tasks over weeks, like a dune slowly shifting rather than appearing overnight. Rewards per identity are capped, so spawning many identities multiplies locked capital without multiplying payout. A lotus-style public ledger of completed tasks lets peers check whether an identity earned its standing or merely bought it, and identities caught copying others' work lose the deposit.
